# netmaker_device (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Netmaker device (host) by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Device (host) ID to look up.

### Read-Only

- `endpoint_ip` (String)
- `endpoint_ipv6` (String)
- `listen_port` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `nodes` (List of String) IDs of this device's per-network Node records.
- `os` (String)
- `public_key` (String)
- `version` (String)
